about.title: About
about.p1: OCD Live gives African sellers visibility through live video: a studio in Lomé (Togo) broadcasts on the House of Challenge TikTok account, and remote sellers are supported by an assistant.
about.p2: The idea: marketing before selling. The live is first used to place your product, your number and your address.
about.p3: OCD Live is an initiative of Bovan Group.
about.principleText: Before you sell, you need to be seen. The live first places your product, your number and your address in front of the audience, so customers contact you directly.

studio.text: You bring your products: the team handles the production and broadcast.

remote.title: Remote live
remote.text: You stay at home, an assistant supports you during your live.

payment.title: Simple booking
payment.text: One slot, one Mobile Money payment, a receipt sent on WhatsApp.

directory.title: Live directory
directory.text: As a subscriber, you appear in your country and category while you are live.

about.studioText: This is where in-person lives are broadcast, on the House of Challenge TikTok account.

real.title: Real products
real.text: Every seller presents real products. Prohibited products are refused.

contact.title: A real contact
contact.text: Your number and address are shown: customers know where to find you.

respect.title: Respect for customers
respect.text: We answer, we deliver, we stay honest. Abuse is reported and handled.

about.contactTitle: A question? We answer on WhatsApp.

terms.title: Terms and cancellation
terms.p1: A booking is confirmed after payment. The chosen slot is held for 10 minutes while you pay, then released.
terms.p2: Rescheduling is free up to 48 hours before the live. A cancellation less than 48 hours before the live is not refunded.
terms.p3: Prohibited products lead to the live being refused and, on repeat, account suspension. The full list will be published by the team.
terms.p4: I present real products, give my real number and address, and answer my customers.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: We keep your WhatsApp number, name, shop, country and bookings to run the service and send you receipts and reminders.
privacy.p2: OCD Live stores no card data: payment goes through an approved provider.
privacy.p3: You can ask for access, correction or deletion of your data by writing to us on WhatsApp. We follow Togolese data protection law and that of the sellers' countries.
